item.text: The existing parser is only a scaffold: it recognizes simple ATX headings and paragraphs, while the renderer escapes every inline construct. I’m replacing that boundary with a deterministic leaf-block model and renderer support for the leaf suite’s inline-facing expectations, including literal code/raw HTML and reference definitions.

The selector also includes container examples, so I’m adding the minimal blockquote/list handling needed by those declared sections rather than treating those failures as out of scope.
